From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Evan Lee <evan@atlasiq.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-05T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: MAP checkpoint: provisioning plan for AtlasIQ (Dedicated + Private)

Hi team / Evan —

Quick weekly MAP checkpoint after Friday’s sizing run. Objective: align on the Dedicated + Private provisioning proposal so we can lock the committed SKU mix by EOW and start the procurement/PO flow. Summary below — please flag any contention items.

High-level proposal (steady-state + burst):
- Dedicated (hosted-managed pool, us-west-2): H100 80GB (8x) + H100 80GB (burst pool, 4x) — target aggregate throughput: 22,000 tokens/sec for low-latency chat workloads; target concurrent sessions: 650
- Private (customer VPC, eu-west-1 initially for EU compliance): A100 40GB (4x) — target: 6,500 tokens/sec aggregate; 180 concurrent sessions
- Edge/burst (us-east-1, lower-cost): L4 48GB (6x) for embedding-heavy batch jobs and overflow — designed for 40% of peak batch load
- Regional failover: plan to route ASGs so that us-west-2 can absorb 60% of eu-west-1 for DR within 5 minutes (warm warm-standby policy)

Notes: numbers are from the capacity-matrix attached (atlasiq-capacity-matrix-20260705.xlsx). We validated per-model perf on the eval harness — results live in the MAP PDF.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Marissa: update the capacity matrix to include vertical scaling steps (H100 -> H100x2 partitions) and send final Excel by Tue 07/07 — OWNER: marissa_cole
- Karthik: confirm quantization/FP16 profile for A100 racks (impact on latency and cost) — OWNER: karthik_iyer — due Tue 07/07
- Kimberly: draft the Dedicated purchase SOW + SLA appendix for AtlasIQ legal — OWNER: kimberly_park — due Thu 07/09
- Laura: finalize routing/failover playbook with Networking and OPS — OWNER: laura_bennett — due Wed 07/08
- Evan / AtlasIQ: confirm any additional compliance constraints for EU VPC (need list of required controls) — OWNER: Evan Lee — requested by Tue 07/07

Attachments: ATQ-MAP-v1.pdf (MAP summary), atlasiq-capacity-matrix-20260705.xlsx (detailed numbers).

Proposed next steps:
- Lock committed SKU counts by EOD Fri 07/09 so procurement can issue quotes next week.
- Weekly checkpoint same time next Monday — if we have signoff on counts, we’ll begin provisioning smoke tests in staging.

Thanks — short meeting notes to follow in thread.

Best,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: provisioning plan for AtlasIQ (Dedicated + Private)

Thanks Dylan — useful summary. A couple quick clarifications from AtlasIQ: 

1) Regional coverage: EU residency is required for PII-processing paths. Can you confirm the private VPC in eu-west-1 will have KMS integration and audit logs forwarded to our SIEM (we'll loop Maria for compliance specifics)?

2) Failover: the 5-minute failover target is fine, but we need a clear runbook that shows session continuity guarantees for logged-in users (sticky sessions, KV cache sync expectations). Is that in the routing playbook?

3) Throughput ask: the aggregate numbers look reasonable. Can you provide expected 95th pct latency for single-turn chat at the proposed H100 config (p50/p95) so we can present to our product team?

I attached our internal procurement window: AtlasIQ needs committed SKU counts to be in place by 07/12 to allocate budget for Q3.

If we get those details this week, legal can move to countersignature.

—Evan
Evan Lee
Head of Cloud Infrastructure | AtlasIQ

Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: provisioning plan for AtlasIQ (Dedicated + Private)

Thanks — noted. Quick updates after I re-ran the throughput sweep this morning: 

- H100 80GB numbers: p50 single-turn latency ~ 38ms, p95 ~ 120ms (chat-generation with our standard prompt set at seq=1024). Those numbers assume continuous batching at 32-token average.
- To hit the 22k tokens/sec steady-state target in us-west-2 we should plan for 10x H100 80GB instead of 8x (margin for autoscaling and background KV cache maintenance). I adjusted the capacity matrix accordingly (see attached revision).
- For EU Private (A100 40GB), the FP16 profile cuts cost ~18% with a small p95 impact (~+10ms). Karthik - can you confirm any model fidelity concerns if we recommend FP16 as the default?

Updated action items (changes in bold):
- Marissa: deliver revised atlasiq-capacity-matrix-20260705.xlsx with 10x H100 in us-west-2 and noted FP16 recommendation for A100s — due Tue 07/07 — OWNER: marissa_cole
- Karthik: confirm FP16/quantization impact and publish a short note for AtlasIQ — due Tue 07/07 — OWNER: karthik_iyer
- Kimberly: proceed with SOW draft; include a clause for regional failover SLAs and warm-standby pricing tiers — OWNER: kimberly_park — due Thu 07/09
- Laura: add KV cache sync section to routing playbook and validate warm-standby recovery time with Ops — OWNER: laura_bennett — due Wed 07/08

I'll also add a short appendix in the MAP PDF that captures the latency sweep graphs.

Marissa
